text:
Alyssa (PM): quick async check for end-of-quarter milestone status — posting a compact heatcheck for the items we promised to ship this quarter. pls reply with: shipped / slipped / blocked + owner + next step. I'll compile.
Sam (Eng Lead): Got it. I'll start with infra-facing items.
Jamie (Platform): will update runtime routing tasks.
Alyssa (PM): 1) Hosted API autoscale tuning — OWNER: Jamie — status: shipped, rolled 2/2 regions yesterday :tada:
Jamie (Platform): shipped. Follow-up tickets for perf knobs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/issues/842 — will close after canary metrics look stable. Deployed config: ``configs/autoscale-v2.yaml``
Sam (Eng Lead): 2) Dedicate capacity billing docs + SDK hooks — OWNER: Sam — status: slipped (missed docs review)
Sam (Eng Lead): slipped. Docs draft is in PR but needs product review: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/517
Ciara (Design): I can review the billing UX wording tomorrow morning. Adding to calendar.
Alyssa (PM): 3) Private deployment onboarding (VPC template + KMS integration) — OWNER: Sam — status: partial (control plane shipped, on-prem packaging slipped)
Sam (Eng Lead): partial. Control plane bits shipped, on-prem installers blocked by packaging test failures on older distros. Next step: pair with infra to get artifact signing working.
Rishi (SRE): I can help tomorrow to debug the packaging signing. ping me when you have logs.
Alyssa (PM): 4) Rollouts: canary / A/B routing UI in Console — OWNER: Ciara — status: slipped -> blocked (UX review + backend gating)
Ciara (Design): blocked on API shape from platform. Waiting on Jamie's PR for rollout policy API.
Jamie (Platform): PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/211 — needs a small tweak for fallback policy. ETA EOD.
Sam (Eng Lead): 5) KV cache prefix caching optimization — OWNER: Sam — status: shipped (perf + 12% token reduction in latency p50)
Sam (Eng Lead): shipped, perf dashboards updated.
deploy-bot: deploy notice: platform/canary v1.12 -> stable at 2026-03-18T14:04Z :white_check_mark:
Alyssa (PM): 6) Evals regression alerts + baseline prompt sets — OWNER: Rishi/Product — status: slipped (missing eval for long-tail prompts)
Rishi (SRE): slipped. Need a volunteer from ML/research to craft the long-tail set. Sam can we allocate 1 engineer to pair?
Sam (Eng Lead): yes, I'll put Kaori on it for 2 days next sprint.
Alyssa (PM): blockers summary: - on-prem packaging (owner: Sam) -> Rishi to assist for signing logs - rollout API tweak (owner: Jamie) -> Jamie EOD PR tweak - docs review for dedicated billing (owner: Sam + Ciara) -> Ciara to QA tomorrow morning
Ciara (Design): will prioritize the billing wording review.
Jamie (Platform): noted. I'll add the fallback policy tests to the PR CI.
Alyssa (PM): next steps: 1) Sam to post a short unblock thread when packaging logs are available 2) Jamie to mark PR ready-for-review and tag @Ciara for UX verification 3) Rishi + Kaori to start eval long-tail set
Sam (Eng Lead): will post logs and a short triage note by 12pm PT tomorrow.
Rishi (SRE): I'll carve out 2 hours to pair with Kaori on the eval harness on Wednesday.
Alyssa (PM): final ask — if anyone has capacity to review docs PR #517 please drop a quick note here. we want to close this before next week's customer demo. :eyes:
Ciara (Design): dropping a review now.
Sam (Eng Lead): thanks all — will follow up in the morning with the packaging thread.
Alyssa (PM): thanks team — I'll compile this into the OKR tracker and ping execs with the short summary after we have the packaging status update. :raised_hands:
